newsitem.title: THAILAND: PRESS DIGEST - Thai newspapers - Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Thai newspapers - Sept 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Thai press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- New Aspiration Party leader Chavalit Yongchaiyudh has expressed confidence that he will emerge as prime minister after the Nov 17 general election. Chavalit says he expects his party to win the most House seats following a meeting on campaign strategy which resolved to announce party's candidates nationwide on Oct 5 or 6. (THE NATION)
- Palang Dharma Party leader Thaksin Shinawatra announces that he will not run in the next general election but his party resolved to retain him as its leader. (THE NATION)

- PM Banharn Silpa-archa cannot be ousted as Chart Thai Party leader, says a senior party official. The comment was made after the party secretary-general Snoh Thienthong has threatened his faction would see Banharn ousted at a party meeting to be held tomorrow. (BANGKOK POST)

- Thai Danu Bank plans to concentrate more on commercial banking, retail banking and investment banking businesses. The bank has at the same time set a 600 million baht budget for an installation new computer technology. (KRUNGTHEP THURAKIJ)

- Thai Satellite Telecommunications Co is interested in joining Motorola's new telecom satellite system costing US$6.1 billion. Motorola executives say the high cost of the system will be spread over many users. (BANGKOK POST)
